additional_info.subject: RE: ID0444498-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R1 170001440]connectors are unavailable CRM:02681000653
additional_info.body:
Hello Francois,
I had the customer's charger checked on-site.
It seems that PLC communication is not the source of the problem.
When checking the dispenser and charger, we found following:
SiD main station -FC2 circuit breaker was down.
Dispenser circuit breaker -FB201 was also down.
When powering them on, we found out that the switch and
SITOP PSU6200 -TB210
do not show any activity.I will attach a video in the ticket
I suspect that the underlying reason for this case is a dead power supply.
Do you agree?
I will order
6EP3334-7SB00-3AX0 (
8EM5903-0AA03-0AA8
)
so we can make the charger work ASAP and do not have to travel to the site twice.
Please confirm the spare part order code.
Thank you very much.
Kind regards,
Milan
